message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout while my kids were in the middle of a board game marathon. I pulled out our trusty lanterns and power banks, and suddenly the living room felt like an adventure zone instead of a dark abyss. My kids took turns pretending to be explorers, using the light to search for 'hidden treasures' in their toy bins. It was a great reminder that with a little creativity, we can turn unexpected moments into fun memories. How do you keep the spirit up during those surprise power outages?
